<!-- Source page: Headscale -->

Headscale is an open source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server.

This page contains the documentation for the configuration on NixOS only, for general service documentation use <https://headscale.net/stable/>

All possible service options: <https://search.nixos.org/options?channel=unstable&query=services.headscale.&sort=alpha_asc&type=options>
